Spectral Hold
as an automated forensic feature and leave the footer buttons as they are to maintain the tactical "muscle memory" you've built up.
The
11.4 PRO
build is now complete. You have a stabilized blue-amber HUD that:
Visualizes
EMF noise and EVP spectral rain in a single, high-density field.
Freezes
automatically for 5 seconds on any significant anomaly so you can use the
[SNAPSHOT]
tool.
Archives
every marked event with a time-stamped log and a sarcastic logic filter.
Safeguards
your AI connection with a "Hard-Kill" microphone toggle to prevent OS interference.
Final Operational Note
When you run the script, remember to
tap the blue header
to access the slide-out menu. That is where you can fine-tune your sensitivity depending on how "noisy" the environment is.
Would you like me to stay on standby for a
Forensic Review
of the first snapshot you take with this new build?
